scene.ko: 항공사 카운터에서 짐을 부치며 보조배터리 규정을 듣고, 앞쪽 자리와 보안 검색대 위치를 묻는다.

lines.en: Hello. Where are you flying to today?
I'm going to Vancouver. Here's my passport.
alt: I'm flying to Vancouver. Here's my passport.
To Vancouver. Here is my passport.

lines.en: Thank you. Are you checking any bags?
Yes, this suitcase. I also have a power bank in my backpack.
lines.ko: 네, 이 여행 가방이요. 배낭에 보조배터리도 있어요.
alt: Yes, this suitcase. There's also a power bank in my backpack.

lines.en: That's fine, but it has to stay in your carry-on.
lines.ko: 괜찮습니다. 하지만 기내 가방에 넣어 두셔야 해요.

lines.en: Got it. Could I get a seat near the front?
lines.ko: 알겠습니다. 앞쪽 자리로 받을 수 있을까요?
alt: Okay. Can I have a seat near the front?
I see. Is there a seat near the front?

lines.en: Sure. Row 8, aisle seat. Boarding starts at 10:20.
Great, thank you. Which way is the security check?
lines.ko: 좋아요, 고마워요. 보안 검색대는 어느 쪽이에요?
alt: Thanks. Where is the security check?
Great. How do I get to security?

lines.en: It's on your left, past the café. Have a nice flight!
lines.ko: 카페를 지나서 왼쪽에 있어요. 즐거운 비행 되세요!
